title: Chose 'leave the dies at the vault-door (Vell +1)' with Sarel at the Hammer Hearth, and the game confirmed 'She sets them herself into a niche cut fresh beside the door.' The ending's 'how the realm remembers you' recap repeats this: 'The struck penny's dies stand in their own niche at Pennywell's vault-door now.' Yet both 'the king's reverse die' and 'the king's obverse die' stayed in my carried inventory for the rest of the run, all the way to the final status screen.
